name: Llama Guard
summary: Meta's open-weight safety classifiers that label LLM prompts and responses as safe or unsafe against the MLCommons hazard taxonomy.
description: Llama Guard 4 is a 12B natively multimodal classifier (text plus multiple images) pruned from Llama 4 Scout, combining Llama Guard 3-8B and 3-11B-vision; it adds a Code Interpreter Abuse category for tool-call use. Weights are gated on Hugging Face under the Llama 4 Community License; earlier versions use the Llama 2/3/3.2 community licenses. Part of Meta's Purple Llama project.
